message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. It features a green background with a red vertical border on the left side. Centered is a dark green and black illustration of a person’s head and shoulders. The person wears a dark balaclava or mask with visible eye holes and a mouth opening. Liquid appears to drip from the eye holes down the mask. The person wears a patterned garment resembling a keffiyeh and a textured vest with dark straps.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, lime-green capital letters across the upper portion of the page. Above this, text reads "KIPRAH ULAMA PEREMPUAN NUSANTARA" and "ADOLF HEUKEN, PENJAGA SEJARAH IBU KOTA". Below the magazine title, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". In the lower right, large white text reads "ENAM TERORIS INSAF". Below this, smaller white text reads "CERITA MANTAN NAPI TERORISME YANG BALIK BADAN. DARI TERSEBAB SURAT BIN LADIN HINGGA TERHARU ATAS PENDERITAAN KORBAN." A barcode and date information are on the lower left.
